page.overview:
Who is Blast-Off?

{| class="wikitable" style="border-collapse:collapse;"

!style="border:1px solid black" colspan=2|Generation 1

Blast-Off was introduced in 1993 as part of the Mega Marines subline of A Real American Hero toys. ---- Appearance: red head covering; blue shirt with dark grey vest and wristbands; red "2" on chest; red gloves; dark grey pants with red boots

Accessories: soft, red full-head helmet; medium blue "Cloudburst" submachine gun; medium blue "'91 Flint" laser rifle; medium blue "'93 Beach-Head" knife; red "Backblast" missile launcher with medium blue trigger; two medium blue "Backblast" missiles; red bio-armor mold; medium blue figure stand. ---- YoJoe.com page/Filecard
